bloc.ISO/IEC #:# — ISO/IEC #:# — Technologies: ISO/IEC #:# — ISO/IEC #:# — Information technology — Artificial intelligence — Management system. Implementing it assumes you hold the text of the standard, which is bought from ISO or from a national standards body (AFNOR in France).
bloc.Le fait qui coûte le plus cher, et qu'au: The most costly fact, and one that no rate shows. An organisation that has implemented thirty-six controls out of thirty-eight and left two boxes empty fails at stage #. An organisation that includes eighteen and excludes twenty, each one justified, passes. Compliance is not counted in ticked boxes: it is counted in boxes decided.
bloc.Les mesures de l'annexe A ne sont pas ex: The Annex A controls are not exhaustive: the standard provides that an organisation designs others if risk treatment requires it. Covering all thirty-eight is therefore not enough to make the statement complete — it is complete if it covers the treatment options selected.
bloc.NON recevable pour un audit d’étape #. L: NOT admissible for a stage-# audit. The statement is NOT admissible for a stage-# audit. This is not a security defect, it is a document defect — and it is put right by writing, not by developing.
bloc.Un article de # à # ne se déclare pas «: A clause from # to # cannot be declared “not applicable”: these are requirements, and they cannot be excluded. Only Annex A controls can be excluded, and only with justification (clause # f)). A “not applicable” declaration placed on a clause is ignored by the engine, which says so.
bloc.Un cycle d'audit interne (art. #) et une: An internal audit cycle (clause #) and a management review (clause #) must have taken place before stage #. These are requirements, and they cannot be manufactured the day before: they leave dated traces, or they have not taken place.

texte.Ce qu'on mesure, comment, à quelle fréqu: What is measured, how, how often, and what is concluded from the measurements.
texte.Ce que la direction doit avoir sous les: What senior management must have in front of it: follow-up of previous reviews, changes, performance, nonconformities, feedback from interested parties.
texte.Ce qui la fait tomber — Un système monté: What makes it fail — A system set up for the audit and abandoned afterwards — visible at the first surveillance audit.
texte.Ce qui la fait tomber — Un écart entre l: What makes it fail — A gap between the Statement of Applicability and reality — an included control whose implementation nothing evidences.
texte.Ce qui la fait tomber — Une déclaration: What makes it fail — An incomplete Statement of Applicability — a control neither included nor excluded, or a decision without justification. The defect is documentary, and it stops everything before stage #.
texte.Certification par un organisme tiers acc: Certification by an accredited third-party body — the only one of Sentinel’s four references that issues a certificate you can show.
texte.Cet article ne se reprend pas d’un systè: This clause does not carry over from an existing management system
texte.Choisir les mesures, vérifier qu'elles c: Choose the controls, check that they cover the treatment options selected, and PRODUCE THE STATEMENT OF APPLICABILITY with the justification for each inclusion and each exclusion.
texte.Compréhension de l'organisme et de son c: Understanding the organization and its context
texte.Dire aux utilisateurs, aux clients et au: Tell users, clients and the public what they need to know — including when things go wrong.
texte.Disponibilité, protection, conservation,: Availability, protection, retention, deletion — including for documents of external origin.
texte.Documentation de la conception et du dév: Documentation of AI system design and development
texte.Documentation des évaluations de l'impac: Documentation of AI system impact assessments
texte.Documentation et informations du système: System documentation and information for users
texte.Donner à la direction une orientation éc: Give senior management written direction and support for AI systems.
texte.Données pour le développement et l'améli: Data for development and enhancement of AI system
texte.Détermination du périmètre du système de: Determining the scope of the AI management system
texte.Encadrer l'usage : pour quoi le système: Frame the use: what the system is intended for, and what you forbid yourself to do with it.
texte.Enregistrement des journaux d'événements: AI system recording of event logs
texte.Faire tourner ce qui a été planifié, maî: Run what has been planned, control changes, and keep hold of outsourced processes.
texte.Fréquence, méthodes, responsabilités, ex: Frequency, methods, responsibilities, reporting requirements — and auditors who do not audit their own work.
texte.Identifier, analyser et évaluer les risq: Identify, analyse and evaluate the risks that AI creates — for the organisation AND for individuals. This dual reading is what distinguishes this assessment from a conventional risk analysis.
texte.Installer la redevabilité : que quelqu'u: Establish accountability: someone answers for each system, and a concern can be escalated.
texte.L'AIDF de l'article # est due par certai: The FRIA under Article # is owed by certain DEPLOYERS of high-risk systems and follows a list of points imposed by the Regulation. A # assessment, however excellent, does not constitute one.
texte.L'AIPD de l'article # porte sur les seul: The DPIA under Article # covers personal data only, and the rights of data subjects. An AI system without personal data does not fall under it; processing without AI falls under it all the same.
texte.L'appréciation des risques, exécutée et: The risk assessment, performed and kept up to date — at planned intervals and when something changes.
texte.L'auditeur vérifie que ce qui est écrit: The auditor checks that what is written is done: evidence of execution, records, interviews.
texte.L'auditeur vérifie que le système EXISTE: The auditor checks that the system EXISTS on paper: scope, policy, risk assessment, Statement of Applicability, internal audit plan.
texte.L'inventaire des systèmes, la cartograph: The inventory of systems, the mapping of affected persons and the impact assessment method also serve the fundamental rights impact assessment (FRIA, art. #).
texte.L'évaluation d'impact, exécutée. C'est i: The impact assessment, performed. This is where the work done for the GDPR DPIA and for the AI Act FRIA carries over — and where it is not enough.
texte.L'évaluation d'impact, vue depuis la pla: The impact assessment, seen from planning: it must be planned, scoped and linked to the risk assessment.
texte.La communication des incidents (A.#) et: Communication of incidents (A.#) and supplier control (A.#) partly overlap measures (b) and (d) of Article #(#).
texte.La déclaration n'est PAS recevable pour: The statement is NOT admissible for a stage # audit. It is not a security defect, it is a document defect — and it is corrected by writing, not by developing.
texte.La provenance et la préparation des donn: Data provenance and preparation feed directly into the records of processing activities and the data protection impact assessment (DPIA, art. #).
texte.La structure harmonisée est la même : re: The harmonised structure is the same: management review, internal audit, nonconformities and documented information graft onto the existing system.
texte.Le certificat vit : des audits périodiqu: The certificate lives on: periodic audits check that the system holds.
texte.Le document court qui dit ce que l'organ: The short document that says what the organisation allows and forbids itself in matters of AI, and that commits its senior management.
texte.Le référentiel de la norme est momentané: The standard’s reference framework is temporarily unavailable. Nothing is shown rather than a partial list: preparing an audit on a truncated scope costs more than waiting for it.
texte.Les changements du système de management: Changes to the management system are planned; they are not discovered after the fact.
texte.Les mesures de l'annexe A ne sont pas ex: Annex A controls are not exhaustive: an organisation can design others, or draw on existing sources, if risk treatment requires it. A Statement of Applicability that covers the thirty-eight Annex A controls is not complete for all that: it is complete if it covers the risk treatment options selected, which may demand more.
texte.Mesures de l’annexe A : A.#, A.#, A.#, A: Annex A controls: A.#, A.#, A.#, A.#
texte.NIS # impose des DÉLAIS — # h, # h, un m: NIS # imposes DEADLINES — # h, # h, one month — that the standard does not set. A compliant # process can entirely miss the Article # clock.
texte.Nommer ce qui, dehors et dedans, pèse su: Name what, outside and inside, weighs on the way the organisation designs or uses AI: market, applicable law, societal expectations, internal maturity.
texte.Objectifs d'IA et planification pour les: AI objectives and planning to achieve them
texte.Objectifs pour un développement responsa: Objectives for responsible development of AI system
texte.Processus d'utilisation responsable des: Processes for responsible use of AI systems
texte.Processus de conception et de développem: Processes for responsible AI system design and development
texte.Qualité des données pour les systèmes d': Quality of data for AI systems
texte.Qui décide, qui met en œuvre, qui contrô: Who decides, who implements, who checks — and who answers when a system misbehaves.
texte.Recenser ce dont les systèmes dépendent: Identify what the systems depend on — data, tools, infrastructure, people — so that you can assess their risks.
texte.Recenser qui a quelque chose à perdre ou: List who has something to lose or to say — clients, employees, people subject to the system’s decisions, regulators — and what each expects.
texte.Répartir les responsabilités avec les fo: Allocate responsibilities with suppliers and clients — and make sure that what you buy holds to the same commitments.
texte.Savoir d'où viennent les données, ce qu': Know where the data comes from, what it is worth, and what has been done to it before training.
texte.Tenir le système de bout en bout : objec: Cover the system end to end: development objectives, design, verification, deployment, operation, logging.
texte.Un cycle d'audit interne (art. #) et une: An internal audit cycle (clause #) and a management review (clause #) must have taken place BEFORE stage # — these are requirements, and the organisation cannot produce them on the day of the audit.
texte.Utilisation prévue du système d'IA: Intended use of the AI system
texte.taux qui dit l’effort réel. Les articles: rate that shows the real effort. The “shareable” clauses graft onto a management system already in place; those marked “specific to AI” are what # adds, and there are only #.
texte.Écrire ce qui est dedans et ce qui est d: Write down what is in and what is out. A vague scope is the first cause of cost overrun in an audit: everything that is not excluded in writing is audited.
texte.Établir, mettre en œuvre, tenir à jour e: Establish, implement, maintain and improve the system itself — the clause that says the rest must exist for real, not just on paper.
texte.Évaluation de l'impact du système d'IA s: Assessing AI system impact on individuals or groups of individuals
texte.Évaluation des impacts sociétaux des sys: Assessing societal impacts of AI systems
texte.Évaluer ce que les systèmes font subir a: Assess what the systems do to individuals, groups and society — the seam with the AI Act and the GDPR.
texte.Être certifié # ne rend conforme à aucun: Being # certified does not make you compliant with any legal obligation and does not exempt you from any; conversely, a system fully compliant with the AI Act is not worth a certified management system. The two feed each other; neither carries the other.
